html:
The war of 533 to 534 in which the eastern Roman empire of Justinian destroyed the kingdom of the Vandals in North Africa. It was the first and quickest of Justinian's wars to win back the west.

The Vandals had held Africa since 429 and taken Carthage in 439. Under Gaiseric their fleet raided across the Mediterranean and sacked Rome in 455. In 530 the pro-Roman king Hilderic was overthrown by his cousin Gelimer, which gave Justinian his excuse.

Belisarius landed in 533 with a small army. He won at Ad Decimum, near Carthage, entered the city, and won again at Tricamarum in December. Gelimer surrendered in early 534 and was led through Constantinople in Belisarius's triumph. Africa became a Roman province again, though years of war with the Berber peoples followed. The success encouraged Justinian to attack the Goths in Italy, starting the Gothic War. Procopius saw the campaign and wrote it up.
sum: The war of 533 to 534 in which the eastern Roman empire of Justinian destroyed the kingdom of the Vandals in North Africa. It was the first and quickest of Justinian's wars to win back the west.
